long_biography.plain_text:
Old Dominion Freight Line's national network bears David Congdon's imprint as an operator who learned the business from its loading docks. He drove trucks and worked as a mechanic before moving through engineering, fleet maintenance, transportation and quality roles. That range shaped his focus on consistent processes across the freight network.

After becoming president, Congdon brought the leadership team together to plan Old Dominion's transition from a regional carrier to a national one. As chief executive, he helped guide geographic expansion and acquisitions while cultivating the company's distinctive operating culture. Congdon moved to executive chairman in 2018, retaining responsibility for strategy and governance after daily leadership passed to successors.
